name: Jira
description: Your Jira Cloud issues in lanes (Backlog, In progress, Mentioned, On hold, Done) with unread marks, read-only towards Jira. Open an issue as a styled page with its images, annotate it and discuss it with Claude in the current tab or a new one. Sorted by priority when Jev triage (bronos.jev-triage) is installed; annotating needs cc-cockpit 0.8.0 or later.
author: BronOS
